Hi Asha / Tom —

Great to meet in the discovery yesterday. Based on the scope you shared, the team and I recommend a 75–90 minute technical deep-dive to walk through:

- production topology and traffic patterns you plan to serve
- deployment options (dedicated vs private) and data controls
- SLOs, KV/prefix caching strategy, and quantization recommendations
- a short Q&A and action items for a follow-up POC sprint

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Nov 24 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Nov 25 — 13:00–14:30 PT

Please let me know which works best and who from your side we should invite (infra lead + PM recommended). I've attached a one-page agenda.

I'll plan to have Marissa (SRE lead) cover the infra checklist and Ben cover the staging/playback approach.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
